verdict.rationale: Evidence shows administrative control mechanisms an engineering lead could use: Claude for Enterprise's role-based permissions and managed policy settings for org-wide configurations, sandboxed Bash tool with configurable file/network allow-lists, and CLI commands to add/remove MCP servers (claude mcp add/serve). This supports the ability to govern which external tools/integrations are reachable, though the pack lacks detail on granular per-tool allow/deny lists, a settings UI, or team-wide enforcement audit trail. Missing for 10: explicit permissions.json/allowlist documentation for individual MCP tools, admin console screenshots, and independent verification that engineering leads actually use these controls in practice.
